onboarding.title: Set up your profile
onboarding.description: A few short steps help us show you the right jobs, training and opportunities. You can skip any step and come back later.
onboarding.age.title: Before we begin
onboarding.age.description: Please confirm your date of birth. It is needed only to protect young people and is never shown to employers.
onboarding.age.whyTitle: Why we ask for your age
onboarding.age.why: Indian data protection rules require a parent or guardian to agree before we use the personal details of anyone under 18. Your date of birth is private: it is not searchable and employers never see it.
onboarding.age.dobHint: Enter it as shown on your ID. You cannot change it here later.
onboarding.guardian.title: A parent or guardian needs to agree
onboarding.guardian.explanation: Because you are under 18, a parent or legal guardian must give consent before you can use the People Portal. Please complete this form together with them.
onboarding.guardian.rule1: We use your details only to show you suitable jobs, internships and training in India.
onboarding.guardian.rule2: Overseas jobs, marketing messages and activity tracking are not available until you turn 18.
onboarding.guardian.rule3: Your guardian can withdraw consent at any time by contacting Venkat Sai support.
onboarding.guardian.formDescription: These details are kept as a record of consent. They are not shared with employers.
onboarding.guardian.name: Parent or guardian's full name
onboarding.guardian.contactHint: Give an email address or a phone number (or both).
onboarding.guardian.phoneHint: Include the country code, for example +91.
onboarding.guardian.statement: I am this person's parent or legal guardian. I have read how Venkat Sai Global uses their personal data and I agree to it being used to show them suitable jobs, internships and training.
onboarding.guardian.contactRequired: Give the guardian's email address or phone number.
onboarding.guardian.consentRequired: Your parent or guardian must tick this box to give consent.
onboarding.guardian.wrongDob: Entered the wrong date of birth?
onboarding.minor.title: Consent recorded
onboarding.minor.description: Your parent or guardian has agreed. Overseas opportunities, marketing messages and tracking stay switched off until you turn 18.
onboarding.step.goals.description: Tell us what you are looking for, so the portal shows the right things first.
onboarding.step.basics.description: Where you are, your experience level and the kind of work you want.
onboarding.step.skills.description: Add the skills you have. You can add levels and years later.
onboarding.step.availability.description: When you can start, how you want to work and what you expect to earn.
onboarding.step.resume.description: Upload a resume if you have one. This is optional.
onboarding.step.visibility.description: Choose who can discover your profile. You can change this at any time.
onboarding.goals.minorNote: Overseas jobs are available from the age of 18.
onboarding.goal.internship.hint: Learn on the job with an employer.
onboarding.goal.overseas.hint: Jobs abroad through licensed recruiting agents. You never pay to apply.
onboarding.skills.hint: Type to search and pick from the list.
onboarding.skills.later: You can mark your main skills and add years of experience on your profile.
onboarding.resume.hint: PDF or Word, up to 10 MB.
onboarding.resume.optional: No resume yet? Skip this step. You can build one later from your profile in Career services.
onboarding.visibility.hint: Your contact details are never shown in search results.
onboarding.visibility.contactNote: Employers see your contact details only after you apply to their job or they unlock your profile, and every view is recorded.
onboarding.done.title: Your profile is set up
onboarding.done.description: Thank you. You can keep improving your profile at any time: complete profiles get better matches.
profile.title: My profile
profile.description: Keep your details up to date. Verified information helps employers trust your profile.
profile.noHeadline: Add a headline so employers know what you do.
profile.overseasMinor: Overseas opportunities are available from the age of 18.
level.none.hint: Verify your email or phone number to reach the first verification level.
level.basic.hint: Your email or phone is verified. Verified ID documents raise your level.
level.documents_verified.hint: Venkat Sai has checked your identity documents.
level.skills_assessed.hint: You passed a Venkat Sai assessment.
completeness.title: Profile strength
completeness.why: Complete profiles get better job matches and are easier for employers to review.
completeness.complete: Your profile is complete. Keep it up to date.
hint.add_summary: Write a short summary about yourself
hint.verify_contact: Verify your email or phone number
hint.add_work_style: Choose employment types and work modes
hint.add_availability: Tell employers when you can start
hint.add_experience: Add your work experience (or mark yourself as a fresher)
hint.add_passport_status: Add your passport status (needed for overseas jobs)
hint.fix_rejected_documents: Fix documents that could not be verified
hint.submit_documents_for_verification: Ask Venkat Sai to verify your documents
hint.review_visibility: Check who can find your profile
photo.title: Profile photo
photo.description: Optional. Employers see it only if you allow it in Privacy & data.
photo.label: Photo
photo.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Location and camera details are removed automatically.
resume.title: Resume
resume.description: Employers you apply to can download it. It is never shown in search results.
resume.label: Resume file
resume.hint: PDF or Word, up to 10 MB.
files.removeHint: To remove the file, use Remove and then Save.
section.personal.description: Private details used to match and verify you. Most are never shown to employers.
section.personal.dialog: Your date of birth cannot be changed here. Gender is optional and never used to rank you.
section.preferences.description: Used to recommend jobs and alert you to new openings.
section.experience.description: Most recent first. Verified entries show a badge.
section.education.description: Schools, colleges, ITI and other qualifications.
section.skills.description: Mark up to five main skills. Skills checked by a Venkat Sai assessment or a verified credential show as verified.
section.languages.description: Languages you can read, write or speak.
section.credentials.description: Add certificates, licences and qualifications. Upload a copy and ask us to verify them.
section.portfolio.description: Photos, videos and projects that show your work.
section.documents.description: Keep your documents in one secure place. You decide which ones employers may see.
section.privacy.description: A summary of what employers can see.
field.legalName.hint: Used for verification and offer letters.
field.dateOfBirth.locked: Private. To correct it, send a correction request from Privacy & data.
field.gender.hint: Optional. Never shown to employers or used in search.
field.gender.private: Only you and Venkat Sai can see this.
field.passport.purpose: Overseas employers and licensed recruiting agents need your passport details to process a job offer. The number is stored encrypted, only the last four characters are shown, and every view by staff is recorded.
field.passportNumber.stored: A number ending in {last4} is saved. Leave blank to keep it.
field.contactMethod.hint: How you would like Venkat Sai to contact you first.
field.headline: Headline
field.headline.hint: For example: “Certified TIG welder, 6 years in pipelines”.
field.about.hint: A few lines about your experience and strengths.
field.experience.suggested: From your work history: about {years} years {months} months.
field.currentEmployer.hint: Hidden from employers unless you allow it in Privacy & data.
field.preferredRoles.hint: Type a role and press Enter. Up to 10.
field.expectedSalary.hint: Optional. Choose the currency and pay period you have in mind.
field.openToOverseas: I am open to overseas jobs
field.openToOverseas.hint: Overseas roles are offered through licensed recruiting agents. You never pay to apply.
field.openToWork.hint: Employers who can find you see that you are looking.
field.supportingDocument.hint: Helps Venkat Sai verify this entry. PDF or image, up to 10 MB.
field.reference.hint: Private. Venkat Sai contacts references only if you allow it in Privacy & data.
field.evidence.hint: Helps Venkat Sai verify this job. PDF or image, up to 10 MB.
field.credentialCopy.hint: Needed before we can verify it. PDF or image, up to 10 MB.
field.linkedSkills.hint: When the certificate is verified, these skills show as verified too.
field.documentFile.hint: PDF, image or Word, up to 10 MB.
field.replaceFile.hint: Leave empty to keep the current file. A new file needs to be verified again.
field.documentNumber.hint: Stored encrypted. Only the last four characters are shown.
field.documentNumber.stored: A number ending in {last4} is saved. Leave blank to keep it.
field.media.hint: Up to 10 photos or PDFs, 15 MB each.
contact.title: Contact details
contact.description: Change your email address or phone number in your account settings, where we verify them.
locations.title: Preferred work locations
locations.hint: List the places you would like to work, most preferred first.
experience.emptyDescription: Add your jobs, apprenticeships and contract work. Freshers can skip this.
education.emptyDescription: Add your school, ITI, diploma or degree.

verification.unverified.hint: Self-declared. Not checked by Venkat Sai yet.

skills.addHint: Search and choose. Selected skills are added to the list below.
skills.removeVerifiedNote: If you remove a verified skill, its verified badge is lost.
assessments.title: Venkat Sai assessments
assessments.description: Trade and skill tests you took with Venkat Sai.
assessments.label: Venkat Sai assessment
assessments.notAccredited: Venkat Sai assessments are practical skill checks. They are not accredited certifications.
credentials.emptyDescription: Certificates you earn on Venkat Sai Global appear here automatically.
credentials.uploadToVerify: Upload a copy to ask for verification.
issuer.venkat_sai.hint: A Venkat Sai skill assessment result. Not an accredited certification.
issuer.accredited_external.hint: Issued by a recognised body, for example NCVT, a sector skill council or an international welding body.
issuer.self_declared.hint: Any other certificate or training you completed.
issuer.venkatSaiNote: Venkat Sai assessments and certificates from training on this platform are added automatically.
portfolio.emptyDescription: Show photos or videos of your work, for example welds, fabrication or finished projects.
portfolio.public.hint: Private items are seen only by you and Venkat Sai.
documents.emptyDescription: You do not need documents to apply. Add them when an employer or Venkat Sai asks.
documents.never: Uploading documents is optional. Only you, authorised Venkat Sai staff and employers you choose can open them.
documents.shareable: Share with employers I apply to
documents.shareable.hint: Turning this off removes employers' access straight away.
documents.sharedOn: Employers you apply to can now see this document
documents.sharedOff: This document is no longer shared with employers
documents.editResets: Changing the file or number means the document must be verified again.
preview.title: How employers see you
preview.description: A preview of your profile using the same privacy rules that apply to employers.
preview.search.title: Employers searching the talent pool
preview.search.explain: Verified employers searching for candidates see this. Your contact details, resume and documents stay hidden until you apply or they unlock your profile.
preview.applied.title: Employers you applied to
preview.applied.explain: When you apply and agree to share your profile, that employer sees your full name, your resume and the documents you marked as shareable. Contact details are revealed on request, and each view is recorded.
preview.notVisible: Employers cannot find your profile in search
preview.notVisible.explain: Your visibility setting or open-to-work status hides you from employer search. Employers you apply to can still see your profile.
preview.contactHidden: Hidden until you apply or the employer unlocks your profile
preview.contactOnReveal: Shown when the employer asks to see it (recorded)
preview.assessmentsHidden: Your passed assessments are hidden because you have not agreed to share them.
preview.referencesPrivate: Reference contacts are never shown to employers.
preview.documentsHidden: Documents are hidden until you apply.
preview.footnote: Gender, date of birth, nationality and passport details are never shown to employers.
enum.visibility.public_to_employers: All employers on Venkat Sai Global
enum.visibility.public_to_employers.hint: Any employer using candidate search can find a masked version of your profile.
enum.visibility.verified_employers.hint: Only employers that Venkat Sai has verified can find you.
enum.visibility.venkat_sai_only.hint: Employers cannot search for you. The Venkat Sai team may suggest you for suitable roles.
enum.visibility.hidden.hint: Nobody can find you. Employers you apply to still see your application.
